name: Qizongzui Siyang Rizhi
source:
[b]When you decide to raise an egg of unknown origin, have you ever wondered if it might one day learn to love you—or learn to hate you?[/b]

In November 2004, you arrive in Talros, a remote seaside town in Britain, to inherit an old mansion left behind by your late grandmother.

A mysterious egg disrupts your otherwise peaceful life.

You must care for it, watch over it as it grows, and gradually teach it about the human world.

But you soon discover that it is no ordinary creature.

It is connected to the legendary Seven Deadly Sins.

And the town you now call home is far from as peaceful as it seems.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5379140/%E4%B8%83%E5%AE%97%E7%BD%AA%E9%A5%B2%E5%85%BB%E6%97%A5%E5%BF%97_7_Deadly_SinsRearing_Log/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[b]当你决定饲养一枚来历不明的蛋时，可曾想过它有朝一日会学会爱你——还是学会恨你？[/b]

2004年11月，你来到英国偏远的海滨小镇塔尔罗斯镇，继承已故祖母留下的一栋老宅。

一枚神秘的蛋打破了你原本平静的生活。

你必须悉心照料它，守望着它一步步成长，并渐渐教导它认识人类的世界。

但你很快便发现，它绝非寻常生物。

它与传说中的“七宗罪”息息相关。

而这座如今被你称作家园的小镇，也远不像表面看起来那样平静安宁。
